name: rarext-protocol
description: The RAREXT protocol and infrastructure for verifiable builds: artifacts, claims, verifiers, and a portable registry for AI agents and builders.

scripts.test: node --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/agent-sdk/test/*.test.ts apps/api/test/*.test.ts apps/web/test/*.test.ts apps/chain/test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:examples: python3 -m unittest discover -s examples/board-games -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s examples/launchpad -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s examples/storage -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s examples/market -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:web
scripts.pretest: npm run build:packages && npm run build:verifiers
